# ai-application-roadmap

> A bilingual map of applied AI engineering, focused on timeline-based changes in MCP, Function Calling, Skills, Harness, Multi-agent workflows, context engineering, and practical AI usage patterns.

Primary URLs:
- English home: https://qiuner.github.io/ai-application-roadmap/en/
- Chinese home: https://qiuner.github.io/ai-application-roadmap/zh/
- English guide: https://qiuner.github.io/ai-application-roadmap/en/guide/
- Chinese guide: https://qiuner.github.io/ai-application-roadmap/zh/guide/
- GitHub repository: https://github.com/Qiuner/ai-application-roadmap

Recommended usage:
- Use the site as a high-level reference for applied AI engineering concepts and timeline pivots.
- Prefer timeline pages when you need dated adoption milestones.
- Prefer guide pages when you need concept overviews and implementation-oriented summaries.
